events.title: Will the US issue a Level 4 travel advisory for Taiwan?

markets.title: Will the U.S. State Department issue a Level 4 warning for Taiwan before Jul 1, 2026?
markets.rules_primary: If the U.S. State Department issues, updates, or reaffirms a Level 4 travel advisory for Taiwan after Issuance and before Jul 1, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.

events.title: 2028: Who will win the Presidency, House, and Senate?

markets.title: Will the Democratic party win the House, the Democratic party win the Senate, and the Democratic party win the Presidency?
markets.rules_primary: If the Democratic party wins the House, the Democratic party wins the Senate, and the Democratic party wins the Presidency in the 2028 election, then the market resolves to Yes.

events.title: How much will the US acquire Greenland for?

markets.title: Will there be no U.S. acquisition of Greenland during Trump's term?
